text: (1) to (3) are committed. (1) 2aa4c8c: lab-kyu-softmatter v3_lab_profile.json carries policy.execution_permission as {reaches: engine, words: v2's words unchanged}, by onboarding Step three alone from answers_20261116_level.json, whose note names 엔진까지 as the option chosen; the record went to v3 with it. (2) 9da6dc8: the Designer copies the level, with words, date, id and revision, from the latest revision of the profile a build names into envelope/execution_permission.json, and writes none where the value is a string. Two things beyond the ask, both needed for an engine tool to build at all: A5 asks no safety row of a tool whose gate opens_by the permission and holds it where the level opens no engine (it held any gated tool with no safety row before); and a first build or a rebuild of such a tool is stopped, writing nothing, where the profile gives no level, since the bundle would fail your B9. (3) cc18833: template v8, LATEST, changes src/gate.py, CLAUDE.md and TEMPLATE.json. The gate opens such a tool, runs_process or writes_files, where the file is a level a person confirmed reaching engine or instrument; otherwise refused_by_safety, code GATE-PERMISSION-001, the level found in message and evidence (none where there is no file); controls_instrument and every gate by safety values are as before; --self-check fails on a permission no person confirmed. run-skill does not name the file: check 24 refuses a session skill naming a path most bundles lack.
